renMemoryRecords.text: Ren, got the carp — twenty-five coins, fair as agreed! This beauty's going straight into a pond-side stew tonight.
Glad it suits you, Sora. The pond's been calm today — that carp had good weight to it. Enjoy the stew.
Thanks, Ren! Calm pond, good carp — perfect. Drop by later and I'll save you a bowl of that stew.
I'll take you up on that, Sora. A bowl of pond-side stew sounds just right after a calm day like this.
